legal_units.title: Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc.
legal_units.text: Where any books of account, other documents, money, bullion, jewellery, virtual digital asset or other valuable article or thing or any information in electronic form as defined in section 261(g) or on a computer system as defined in section 261(e) or any computer system containing the said information, is found in the possession or control of any person in the course of a search under section 247 or survey under section 253, it may, in any proceeding under this Act, be presumed—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 524 Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc. Section 524(1): Where any books of account, other documents, money, bullion, jewellery, virtual digital asset or other valuable article or thing or any information in electronic form as defined in section 261(g) or on a computer system as defined in section 261(e) or any computer system containing the said information, is found in the possession or control of any person in the course of a search under section 247 or survey under section 253, it may, in any proceeding under this Act, be presumed—

legal_units.title: Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc.
legal_units.text: that such books of account, other documents, money, bullion, jewellery, virtual digital asset or other valuable article or thing such information or computer system belong or belongs to such person;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 524 Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc. Section 524(1): Where any books of account, other documents, money, bullion, jewellery, virtual digital asset or other valuable article or thing or any information in electronic form as defined in section 261(g) or on a computer system as defined in section 261(e) or any computer system containing the said information, is found in the possession or control of any person in the course of a search under section 247 or survey under section 253, it may, in any proceeding under this Act, be presumed— Section 524(1)(a): that such books of account, other documents, money, bullion, jewellery, virtual digital asset or other valuable article or thing such information or computer system belong or belongs to such person;

legal_units.title: Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc.
legal_units.text: that the contents of such books of account and other documents or such information or computer system are true;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 524 Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc. Section 524(1): Where any books of account, other documents, money, bullion, jewellery, virtual digital asset or other valuable article or thing or any information in electronic form as defined in section 261(g) or on a computer system as defined in section 261(e) or any computer system containing the said information, is found in the possession or control of any person in the course of a search under section 247 or survey under section 253, it may, in any proceeding under this Act, be presumed— Section 524(1)(b): that the contents of such books of account and other documents or such information or computer system are true;

legal_units.title: Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc.
legal_units.text: that the signature and every other part of such books of account and other documents, which purports to be in the handwriting of any particular person, or which may reasonably be assumed to have been signed by, or to be in the handwriting of, any particular person, are in the handwriting of that person;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 524 Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc. Section 524(1): Where any books of account, other documents, money, bullion, jewellery, virtual digital asset or other valuable article or thing or any information in electronic form as defined in section 261(g) or on a computer system as defined in section 261(e) or any computer system containing the said information, is found in the possession or control of any person in the course of a search under section 247 or survey under section 253, it may, in any proceeding under this Act, be presumed— Section 524(1)(c): that the signature and every other part of such books of account and other documents, which purports to be in the handwriting of any particular person, or which may reasonably be assumed to have been signed by, or to be in the handwriting of, any particular person, are in the handwriting of that person;

legal_units.title: Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc.
legal_units.text: in the case of a document stamped, executed or attested, that it was duly stamped and executed or attested by the person by whom it purports to have been so executed or attested; and
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 524 Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc. Section 524(1): Where any books of account, other documents, money, bullion, jewellery, virtual digital asset or other valuable article or thing or any information in electronic form as defined in section 261(g) or on a computer system as defined in section 261(e) or any computer system containing the said information, is found in the possession or control of any person in the course of a search under section 247 or survey under section 253, it may, in any proceeding under this Act, be presumed— Section 524(1)(d): in the case of a document stamped, executed or attested, that it was duly stamped and executed or attested by the person by whom it purports to have been so executed or attested; and

legal_units.text: that exchange of such information in electronic form, or on such computer system purported to be exchanged between any parties, is exchanged between the parties thereto.

legal_units.title: Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc.
legal_units.text: Where any books of account, other documents or assets have been delivered to the requisitioning officer as per section 248, then, the provisions of sub- section (1) shall apply as if such books of account, other documents or assets, which had been taken into custody from the person referred to in sub-section (1)(a) or (b) or (c) of the said section, had been found in the possession or control of that person in the course of a search under section 247.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 524 Presumption as to assets, books of account, etc. Section 524(2): Where any books of account, other documents or assets have been delivered to the requisitioning officer as per section 248, then, the provisions of sub- section (1) shall apply as if such books of account, other documents or assets, which had been taken into custody from the person referred to in sub-section (1)(a) or (b) or (c) of the said section, had been found in the possession or control of that person in the course of a search under section 247.
